photos.desc: - 37 - Bois secs. — Été, automne. Cortinaire violet. — Cortinarius violaceus. — Comestible, peu délicat. —
Cortinarius violaceus : specimen photographed on the slopes of a volcano, in a beech forest ( Fagus sylvatica ), at an altitude of 1100 m, in Haute-Loire, France.
For more information about this, see the observation page at Mushroom Observer.
Gills of Cortinarius violaceus , note the rust-brown color the gills are turning from the spores.
